
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/Johny-zhao/p/23101767" title="发布于 2026-09-23 23:46">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Ubuntu 25.10 Server 部署 Claude Code 与 Agent 完整指南</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h1><span>一、前置条件与系统准备</span></h1>
<h3><span>1.1 系统要求确认</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>Claude Code 在 Ubuntu 20.04 及以上版本均受支持，Ubuntu 25.10 Server 完全兼容。硬件方面需要至少 4 GB RAM，处理器为 x64 或 ARM64 架构。网络方面需要能够访问 Anthropic API 端点（<a href="https://claude.ai/" rel="noopener nofollow" target="_blank"><span>claude.ai</span></a><span> 和 <a href="https://api.anthropic.com/" rel="noopener nofollow" target="_blank"><span>api.anthropic.com</span></a><span>）。</span></span></span></p>
<h3><span>1.2 更新系统与安装基础依赖</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>以 root 或具备 sudo 权限的用户登录服务器，依次执行：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">sudo <span class="token function">apt update <span class="token operator">&amp;&amp; <span class="token function">sudo <span class="token function">apt upgrade <span class="token parameter variable">-y
<span class="token function">sudo <span class="token function">apt <span class="token function">install <span class="token parameter variable">-y <span class="token function">curl jq <span class="token function">git build-essential</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><code>jq</code><span> 用于后续 JSON 配置处理，<code>git</code><span> 用于 Agent 项目中的版本控制操作，<code>build-essential</code><span> 确保编译工具链完整。</span></span></span></p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">注意事项<span>：Ubuntu 25.10 的软件源可能包含较新版本的包，如果 <code>apt upgrade</code><span> 提示需要重启，建议先重启完成内核更新再继续。</span></span></p>
<h2><span>二、安装 Claude Code</span></h2>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>Claude Code 提供三种安装方式：原生脚本安装（推荐）、npm 全局安装、以及 Linux 包管理器安装（apt/dnf/apk）。推荐使用原生脚本方式，该方式自动处理依赖并在后台保持更新。</span></p>
<h3><span>2.1 原生脚本安装（推荐）</span></h3>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">curl <span class="token parameter variable">-fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh <span class="token operator">| <span class="token function">bash</span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>安装完成后，刷新 Shell 配置以使 <code>claude</code><span> 命令生效：</span></span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token builtin class-name">source ~/.bashrc</span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>如果使用 zsh，则执行 <code>source ~/.zshrc</code><span>。</span></span></p>
<h3><span>2.2 验证安装</span></h3>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>claude <span class="token parameter variable">--version</span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>如果命令未找到，检查 <code>~/.local/bin</code><span> 是否在 PATH 中：</span></span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token builtin class-name">echo <span class="token string">'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' <span class="token operator">&gt;&gt; ~/.bashrc
<span class="token builtin class-name">source ~/.bashrc</span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>也可以运行内置诊断命令检查安装状态：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>claude doctor</pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>该命令会检查 PATH 配置、安装状态和自动更新设置。</span></p>
<h3><span>2.3 替代方式：npm 安装</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>如果原生脚本因网络原因失败，可使用 npm 方式。确保 Node.js 18+ 已安装：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">curl <span class="token parameter variable">-fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_20.x <span class="token operator">| <span class="token function">sudo <span class="token parameter variable">-E <span class="token function">bash -
<span class="token function">sudo <span class="token function">apt-get <span class="token function">install <span class="token parameter variable">-y nodejs
<span class="token function">node <span class="token parameter variable">--version  <span class="token comment"># 确认 &gt;= 18</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>然后全局安装（不要使用 sudo npm，以避免权限问题）<span>：</span></span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">npm <span class="token function">install <span class="token parameter variable">-g @anthropic-ai/claude-code</span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<h3><span>2.4 替代方式：Snap 安装</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>Ubuntu 25.10 Server 默认支持 Snap。社区维护的 Snap 包可用<span>：</span></span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">sudo snap <span class="token function">install claude-code</span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>注意这是社区维护的封装包，不是 Anthropic 官方发布。</span></p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">安装方式选择建议<span>：优先使用原生脚本安装。Snap 方式因其严格沙箱限制，Agent 需要访问项目文件时可能需要额外配置文件系统权限。</span></p>
<h2><span>三、配置 API Token</span></h2>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>Claude Code 通过环境变量读取 API 密钥。API Key 需要从 Claude Console（<a href="https://platform.claude.com/" rel="noopener nofollow" target="_blank"><span>platform.claude.com</span></a><span>）创建和获取。</span></span></p>
<h3><span>3.1 获取 API Key</span></h3>
<ol start="1">
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>访问 <code>https://platform.claude.com/</code><span>，使用 Anthropic 账户登录</span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>进入 “API Keys” 页面</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>点击 “Create Key”，复制生成的密钥（格式为 <code>sk-ant-api03-...</code><span>）</span></span></p>
</li>
</ol>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">重要<span>：API Key 仅在创建时显示一次，务必立即保存到安全位置。</span></p>
<h3><span>3.2 方式一：临时环境变量（适合测试）</span></h3>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token builtin class-name">export <span class="token assign-left variable">ANTHROPIC_API_KEY<span class="token operator">=<span class="token string">"sk-ant-api03-你的密钥"</span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>这种方式仅在当前 Shell 会话中生效，关闭终端后失效。</span></p>
<h3><span>3.3 方式二：写入 ~/.bashrc（推荐，持久生效）</span></h3>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token builtin class-name">echo <span class="token string">'export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="sk-ant-api03-你的密钥"' <span class="token operator">&gt;&gt; ~/.bashrc
<span class="token builtin class-name">source ~/.bashrc</span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>验证设置是否生效：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token builtin class-name">echo <span class="token variable">$ANTHROPIC_API_KEY</span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">安全注意事项<span>：<code>~/.bashrc</code><span> 中的密钥以明文存储，在多用户共享服务器上建议改用 <code>.env</code><span> 文件配合 <code>dotenv</code><span> 加载，或使用密钥管理工具。确保 <code>.bashrc</code><span> 文件权限为 600：</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">chmod <span class="token number">600 ~/.bashrc</span></span></pre>
</div>
<h3><span>3.4 方式三：使用 .env 文件（适合 Agent 项目）</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>在 Agent 项目目录中创建 <code>.env</code><span> 文件：</span></span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token builtin class-name">echo <span class="token string">'ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-api03-你的密钥' <span class="token operator">&gt; .env</span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>并添加 <code>.env</code><span> 到 <code>.gitignore</code><span>，防止密钥被提交到版本库：</span></span></span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token builtin class-name">echo <span class="token string">'.env' <span class="token operator">&gt;&gt; .gitignore</span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>在 Python Agent 代码中通过 <code>python-dotenv</code><span> 加载：</span></span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>pip <span class="token function">install python-dotenv</span></pre>
</div>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">python</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token keyword">from dotenv <span class="token keyword">import load_dotenv
load_dotenv<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">)</span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<h3><span>3.5 方式四：settings.json 全局配置</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>Claude Code 也支持通过 <code>~/.claude/settings.json</code><span> 的 <code>env</code><span> 字段配置环境变量。创建或编辑该文件：</span></span></span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">mkdir <span class="token parameter variable">-p ~/.claude
<span class="token function">cat <span class="token operator">&gt; ~/.claude/settings.json <span class="token operator">&lt;&lt; <span class="token string">'EOF'
{
  "env": {
    "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY": "sk-ant-api03-你的密钥"
  }
}
EOF
<span class="token function">chmod <span class="token number">600 ~/.claude/settings.json</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<h3><span>3.6 企业代理环境配置</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>如果服务器位于企业内网需要通过代理访问外网，配置标准代理环境变量<span>：</span></span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token builtin class-name">export <span class="token assign-left variable">HTTPS_PROXY<span class="token operator">=https://proxy.example.com:8080
<span class="token builtin class-name">export <span class="token assign-left variable">HTTP_PROXY<span class="token operator">=http://proxy.example.com:8080
<span class="token builtin class-name">export <span class="token assign-left variable">NO_PROXY<span class="token operator">=<span class="token string">"localhost,127.0.0.1"</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>同样建议将这些写入 <code>~/.bashrc</code><span> 以持久生效。如果使用自建 LLM Gateway，可额外设置 <code>ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL</code><span> 指向网关地址。</span></span></span></p>
<h2><span>四、部署 Agent 智能体</span></h2>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>Claude Code 的 Agent 能力通过 Agent SDK 实现。Python SDK 和 TypeScript SDK 均捆绑了原生 Claude Code 二进制文件，安装 SDK 后无需单独安装 Claude Code。</span></p>
<h3><span>4.1 创建 Agent 项目目录</span></h3>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">mkdir <span class="token parameter variable">-p ~/my-agent <span class="token operator">&amp;&amp; <span class="token builtin class-name">cd ~/my-agent</span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>Agent 默认有权访问该目录及其子目录中的文件。</span></p>
<h3><span>4.2 安装 Agent SDK</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">Python 方式（推荐）<span> ：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>python3 <span class="token parameter variable">-m venv .venv
<span class="token builtin class-name">source .venv/bin/activate
pip <span class="token function">install claude-agent-sdk</span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">关键注意事项<span>：Ubuntu 25.10 的 Python 启用了 PEP 668 的 externally-managed-environment 保护，必须使用虚拟环境<span>，直接 <code>pip install</code><span> 到系统 Python 会报错。</span></span></span></p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">TypeScript 方式<span>：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">npm init <span class="token parameter variable">-y
<span class="token function">npm pkg <span class="token builtin class-name">set <span class="token assign-left variable">type<span class="token operator">=module
<span class="token function">npm <span class="token function">install @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk
<span class="token function">npm <span class="token function">install --save-dev tsx</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<h3><span>4.3 编写 Agent 脚本</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>创建一个简单的代码审查 Agent。在项目目录下创建 <code>agent.py</code><span>：</span></span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">python</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token keyword">import asyncio
<span class="token keyword">import os
<span class="token keyword">from dotenv <span class="token keyword">import load_dotenv
<span class="token keyword">from claude_agent_sdk <span class="token keyword">import query

load_dotenv<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">)

<span class="token keyword">async <span class="token keyword">def <span class="token function">main<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">:
    prompt <span class="token operator">= <span class="token triple-quoted-string string">"""
    审查当前目录下的所有 Python 文件，找出以下问题：
    1. 未处理的异常和边界条件
    2. 安全漏洞（如硬编码密钥、SQL注入风险）
    3. 性能瓶颈
    对于每个问题，给出具体的文件路径、行号、问题描述和修复建议。
    """
    
    <span class="token keyword">async <span class="token keyword">for message <span class="token keyword">in query<span class="token punctuation">(prompt<span class="token operator">=prompt<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">:
        <span class="token keyword">print<span class="token punctuation">(message<span class="token punctuation">)

<span class="token keyword">if __name__ <span class="token operator">== <span class="token string">"__main__"<span class="token punctuation">:
    asyncio<span class="token punctuation">.run<span class="token punctuation">(main<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">)</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>Agent SDK 支持通过 <code>env</code><span> 选项传入自定义环境变量。Python SDK 会将 <code>env</code><span> 参数与继承的环境合并，因此父进程中已设置的 <code>ANTHROPIC_API_KEY</code><span> 会被自动传递。</span></span></span></span></p>
<h3><span>4.4 运行 Agent</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>确保 API Key 已在当前 Shell 中设置：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token builtin class-name">source .venv/bin/activate
<span class="token builtin class-name">export <span class="token assign-left variable">ANTHROPIC_API_KEY<span class="token operator">=<span class="token string">"sk-ant-api03-你的密钥"
python agent.py</span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>Agent 将自动读取目录中的代码文件，执行分析并输出结果。</span></p>
<h3><span>4.5 在 Claude Code CLI 中直接使用 Agent</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>除了 SDK 编程方式，也可以在 Claude Code 交互式会话中直接调用 Agent 能力。启动 Claude Code：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token builtin class-name">cd ~/my-agent
claude</span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>在交互会话中，可以使用 <code>/agents</code><span> 命令查看和管理可用的子代理（subagent）。Claude Code 支持自定义子代理，当提示词中包含 <code>@agent-name</code><span> 时，该子代理会作为主会话代理运行。</span></span></span></p>
<h3><span>4.6 创建 CLAUDE.md 项目上下文文件</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>在项目根目录创建 <code>CLAUDE.md</code><span> 文件，为 Agent 提供项目特定的上下文和约定：</span></span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">markdown</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token title important"><span class="token punctuation"># 项目约定

<span class="token title important"><span class="token punctuation">## 代码风格
<span class="token list punctuation">- Python 使用 PEP 8
<span class="token list punctuation">- 函数必须包含类型注解
<span class="token list punctuation">- 所有公共函数必须有 docstring

<span class="token title important"><span class="token punctuation">## 安全规则
<span class="token list punctuation">- 禁止在代码中硬编码任何密钥
<span class="token list punctuation">- 数据库查询必须使用参数化查询

<span class="token title important"><span class="token punctuation">## 目录结构
<span class="token list punctuation">- src/ 源代码
<span class="token list punctuation">- tests/ 测试文件
<span class="token list punctuation">- docs/ 文档</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>Claude Code 启动时会自动加载 <code>CLAUDE.md</code><span> 中的上下文。</span></span></p>
<h2><span>五、测试与验证</span></h2>
<h3><span>5.1 基础功能测试</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>在项目目录中创建测试文件：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">cat <span class="token operator">&gt; test_code.py <span class="token operator">&lt;&lt; <span class="token string">'EOF'
def divide(a, b):
    return a / b

def get_user(db, user_id):
    query = f"SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = {user_id}"
    return db.execute(query)
EOF</span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>该文件包含两个典型问题：<code>divide</code><span> 函数未处理除零异常，<code>get_user</code><span> 函数存在 SQL 注入风险。</span></span></span></p>
<h3><span>5.2 使用 Claude Code CLI 测试</span></h3>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token builtin class-name">cd ~/my-agent
claude <span class="token string">"分析 test_code.py 中的安全问题并给出修复方案"</span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>预期输出应包含：除零异常未被捕获、SQL 注入风险、以及相应的修复代码。</span></p>
<h3><span>5.3 使用 Agent SDK 测试</span></h3>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token builtin class-name">source .venv/bin/activate
python agent.py</span></pre>
</div>
<h3><span>5.4 验证 API 连通性</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>如果上述测试失败，先确认 API 连通性：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">curl <span class="token parameter variable">-s <span class="token parameter variable">-o /dev/null <span class="token parameter variable">-w <span class="token string">"%{http_code}" <span class="token punctuation">\
  <span class="token parameter variable">-H <span class="token string">"x-api-key: <span class="token variable">$ANTHROPIC_API_KEY" <span class="token punctuation">\
  <span class="token parameter variable">-H <span class="token string">"anthropic-version: 2023-06-01" <span class="token punctuation">\
  https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages <span class="token punctuation">\
  <span class="token parameter variable">-d <span class="token string">'{"model":"claude-sonnet-4-20250514","max_tokens":10,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}'</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>返回 <code>200</code><span> 表示 API 连通正常；返回 <code>401</code><span> 表示密钥无效；返回 <code>403</code><span> 表示地区限制或权限不足。</span></span></span></span></p>
<h2><span>六、注意事项汇总</span></h2>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">网络与地区限制<span>：Anthropic API 对部分国家/地区有访问限制。如果服务器位于受限地区，需要配置代理或使用支持的 API 网关。安装和运行 Claude Code 需要能够访问 <a href="https://claude.ai/" rel="noopener nofollow" target="_blank"><span>claude.ai</span></a><span> 和 Anthropic API 端点。</span></span></p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">Python 虚拟环境强制要求<span>：Ubuntu 25.10 的 Python 3.13 启用了 PEP 668 保护，Agent SDK 必须安装在虚拟环境中。创建虚拟环境后，每次运行 Agent 前需先激活：<code>source .venv/bin/activate</code><span>。</span></span></p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">密钥安全管理<span>：API Key 应以明文出现在 <code>.bashrc</code><span>、<code>.env</code><span> 或 <code>settings.json</code><span> 中时，确保文件权限为 600。在多用户服务器上，考虑使用 <code>env</code><span> 命令通过进程环境传递密钥，避免写入磁盘文件。<code>.env</code><span> 必须加入 <code>.gitignore</code><span>，防止密钥泄露到版本库。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">Snap 沙箱限制<span>：如果使用 Snap 方式安装 Claude Code，Snap 的严格沙箱机制可能阻止 Agent 访问项目目录中的文件。需要按照 Snap 包文档配置文件系统访问权限，或将项目放在 Snap 允许访问的目录中。</span></p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">代理环境变量优先级<span>：Claude Code 按照 <code>https_proxy</code><span>、<code>HTTPS_PROXY</code><span>、<code>http_proxy</code><span>、<code>HTTP_PROXY</code><span> 的顺序读取代理配置，第一个被设置的变量生效。同时设置大小写变体时注意优先级顺序。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">Agent SDK 与 CLI 的关系<span>：Agent SDK 捆绑了原生 Claude Code 二进制文件，安装 SDK 后无需单独安装 CLI。但如果 SDK 无法自动解析捆绑的 CLI 路径，可以手动指定<span>：</span></span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token builtin class-name">export <span class="token assign-left variable">CLAUDE_BIN<span class="token operator">=<span class="token string">"/usr/local/bin/claude"</span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">自动更新<span>：原生脚本安装的 Claude Code 会在后台自动更新。如果服务器环境要求版本锁定，需要禁用自动更新或使用 Snap/npm 方式安装并手动控制版本。</span></p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">资源消耗<span>：Agent 执行复杂任务时会进行大量文件读取和代码分析，在低配服务器上可能消耗较多内存。建议监控内存使用情况，必要时限制 Agent 的文件访问范围。</span></p>

</div>
